facts.fact: Libya's Audit Bureau and Tunisia's Court of Auditors signed and adopted a roadmap in Amman on 2026-08-15 to activate their cooperation agreement, covering development of digital systems, AI and its governance, and audit-technology capacity building (Libya's Audit Bureau, via Libya Observer).

systems.country_label: Arab Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions
systems.tiers: venue only: the roadmap was signed on the sidelines of its 50th-anniversary ceremony

note: Roadmap between two African state audit institutions, signed on the date given; counted as an agreement between two African governments.
